_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Keep dry_run true until you have read a generated letter end to end.
_notes: Leave smtp_pass empty and set the PRIVACYLOOP_SMTP_PASS environment variable instead.
Gmail needs an App Password, not your account password: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords
use_tls false means implicit SSL on port 465 instead of STARTTLS on 587.
Send from an address you can live with brokers having. They already have it.
